cardOverview.overviewText: A Pulse card designed for health and wellness, providing insurance cover, fitness-related rewards, milestone perks, and lifestyle benefits.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Get an air accident cover of 50 lakhs, zero liability cover of 1 lakh, and other travel insurance covers, including lost baggage, delayed baggage, loss of travel documents, etc.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
